name: vaultcast
title: Vaultcast
description: Search, copy and paste credentials from CLI-based password managers
author: SemL

commands.name: search-passwords
commands.title: Search Passwords
commands.description: Search and copy credentials from configured password manager CLIs

preferences.name: defaultManagerId
preferences.title: Default Manager
preferences.description: Password manager to use by default. Choose "Auto" to use the first available adapter.

preferences.name: externalAdaptersDirectory
preferences.title: External Adapters Directory
preferences.description: Folder containing third-party adapter subfolders (each with pwm-adapter.json). Defaults to ~/.config/vaultcast/adapters (%USERPROFILE%\.config\vaultcast\adapters on Windows).

preferences.name: defaultManagerOverride
preferences.title: Default Manager Override
preferences.description: Optional adapter ID override (e.g. for external adapters). Takes precedence over the Default Manager dropdown.

preferences.name: cliPathOverrides
preferences.title: CLI Path Overrides (JSON)
preferences.description: Optional JSON map of adapter ID to CLI binary path, e.g. {"1password": "/opt/homebrew/bin/op"} on macOS or {"protonpass": "C:\\Users\\you\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\pass-cli\\pass-cli.exe"} on Windows

preferences.name: closeAfterCopy
preferences.label: Close window after copying
preferences.description: Close Raycast after copying a credential to the clipboard.

preferences.name: autoCopyTotpAfterPassword
preferences.label: Auto-copy TOTP after password action
preferences.description: After copying or pasting a password, automatically copy the TOTP code after 5 seconds.

preferences.name: enableExtensionSession
preferences.label: Enable extension session
preferences.description: Keep your master password/PIN in memory and re-unlock password managers automatically until the session times out or Raycast quits. Nothing is written to disk.

preferences.name: sessionTimeoutMinutes
preferences.title: Session Timeout (Minutes)
preferences.description: Lock after this many minutes of inactivity (1–1440). With extension session: unlock with Touch ID (macOS) to resume. Without: unlock the password manager again.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
